records.jp: 行こう！
records.en_original: Okay!
records.en_auxiliary: Okay!
records.en: Let's go!

records.jp: こっち
records.en_original: Over here.
records.en_auxiliary: Over here.
records.en: This way.

records.jp: 今日は、こっちに来ると良いことがあるの？
records.en_original: Did you have some kind of premonition about coming here?
records.en_auxiliary: Did you have some kind of premonition about coming here?
records.en: Will something good happen if we come this way today?

records.jp: ……違う。<CR>きららが、ここに来たかったから、来た
records.en_original: No. I simply wanted to.
records.en_auxiliary: No. I simply wanted to.
records.en: ...No.<CR>Kirara came here because Kirara wanted to.

records.jp: 窓から見える景色、綺麗だから。<CR>愛央と一緒に見たいと思って……
records.en_original: I thought this view was quite pretty. I wanted you to see it.
records.en_auxiliary: I thought this view was quite pretty. I wanted you to see it.
records.en: The view from the window is beautiful.<CR>Kirara wanted to see it together with Ao...

records.jp: で、でも、別の場所がいいなら占ってみる
records.en_original: B-but I can try to divine another place if you prefer.
records.en_auxiliary: B-but I can try to divine another place if you prefer.
records.en: B-but if Ao would prefer somewhere else, Kirara can try divining one.

records.jp: なんで？　いいじゃん、ここで
records.en_original: Why would I? This place is great!
records.en_auxiliary: Why would I? This place is great!
records.en: Why? This place is great.

records.en_original: Huh...?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh...?
records.en: Huh...?

records.jp: きららの言う通り、めっちゃ景色いいし！<CR>最高の場所じゃん！
records.en_original: You were totally right, the view is incredible!
records.en_auxiliary: You were totally right, the view is incredible!
records.en: Just like you said, the view is amazing!<CR>This place is the best!

records.jp: ……きららの好きな場所、喜んでもらえた
records.en_original: I'm...glad you like it.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm...glad you like it.
records.en: ...Ao was happy with a place Kirara likes.

records.jp: こんなん、喜ぶに決まってるよ！<CR>友達が教えてくれたことは、なんでも嬉しいじゃん
records.en_original: Of course I like it! I'm always happy to get a suggestion from a friend!
records.en_auxiliary: Of course I like it! I'm always happy to get a suggestion from a friend!
records.en: Of course I would be happy!<CR>Anything a friend shows me makes me happy.

records.jp: そう……なのか……
records.en_original: I...see.
records.en_auxiliary: I...see.
records.en: Is... that so...?

records.jp: 周りの人が求めたのは、神の声だった。<CR>きららの声じゃない……
records.en_original: The people around me always only ever cared about the words of the Divine. Never my own.
records.en_auxiliary: The people around me always only ever cared about the words of the Divine. Never my own.
records.en: What the people around Kirara wanted was the Divine's voice.<CR>Not Kirara's voice...

records.jp: だから、きららの考えとか気持ちとか、<CR>言ってもいいのか、分からなかった
records.en_original: I always felt like there was no place for my own opinions.
records.en_auxiliary: I always felt like there was no place for my own opinions.
records.en: So Kirara did not know whether it was all right<CR>to speak Kirara's own thoughts and feelings.

records.jp: ……もしかして。<CR>それがずっと、不安だったとか？
records.en_original: Have you been worrying about that all this time?
records.en_auxiliary: Have you been worrying about that all this time?
records.en: ...Could it be<CR>that this has been worrying you all along?

records.jp: うん。力を失くしたら、誰もきららを<CR>見てくれないと思っていた。……でも
records.en_original: Yes. I thought maybe without my power, no one would want me...
records.en_auxiliary: Yes. I thought maybe without my power, no one would want me...
records.en: Yes. Kirara thought that if Kirara lost her power,<CR>no one would look at Kirara anymore... But...

records.jp: 愛央は、今のきららと一緒にいてくれる
records.en_original: But you are here with me. Even as I am.
records.en_auxiliary: But you are here with me. Even as I am.
records.en: Ao stays with Kirara as Kirara is now.

records.jp: ……この力がなくても、きららのこと<CR>見てくれる人がいるって、分かってた
records.en_original: Now I know that there are people who see me for more than my power.
records.en_auxiliary: Now I know that there are people who see me for more than my power.
records.en: ...Kirara knew there were people who would see Kirara<CR>even without this power.

records.jp: でも、怖かった。<CR>今の自分を、受け入れるのが怖かった
records.en_original: I was scared to accept this new me.
records.en_auxiliary: I was scared to accept this new me.
records.en: But Kirara was afraid.<CR>Afraid to accept the person Kirara is now.

records.jp: そうしたら、もう二度と<CR>神の声が聞けないような気がして
records.en_original: I thought that if I did, the Divine would never speak to me again.
records.en_auxiliary: I thought that if I did, the Divine would never speak to me again.
records.en: Kirara felt that if she did,<CR>she would never hear the Divine's voice again.

records.jp: だけど。<CR>さっき、嬉しかった
records.en_original: But just now, I felt happy.
records.en_auxiliary: But just now, I felt happy.
records.en: But...<CR>just now, Kirara was happy.

records.jp: 神じゃなく、きららが選んだ場所で<CR>愛央が笑ってくれたこと
records.en_original: The Divine didn't choose this place, I did. And yet, you still said you liked it.
records.en_auxiliary: The Divine didn't choose this place, I did. And yet, you still said you liked it.
records.en: Because Ao smiled in a place chosen by Kirara,<CR>not by the Divine.

records.jp: 友達って、言ってくれたこと……
records.en_original: You called me your friend.
records.en_auxiliary: You called me your friend.
records.en: Because Ao called Kirara a friend...

records.jp: きらら……
records.en_original: Kirara...
records.en_auxiliary: Kirara...
records.en: Kirara...

records.jp: ……愛央。きららは力を失っても<CR>きららのまま、この世界に立っていたい
records.en_original: Ao. I want to stand on my own two feet in this world. I don't want to need my power.
records.en_auxiliary: Ao. I want to stand on my own two feet in this world. I don't want to need my power.
records.en: ...Ao. Even if Kirara loses her power,<CR>Kirara wants to stand in this world as Kirara.

records.jp: 決めたのだ。きららは、みんなと一緒に<CR>元の世界に戻るって
records.en_original: I've decided to return to the other world with everyone.
records.en_auxiliary: I've decided to return to the other world with everyone.
records.en: Kirara has decided.<CR>Kirara will return to the original world together with everyone.

records.jp: たとえ神がいなくても。<CR>きららは、きららで在り続ける
records.en_original: Even if the Divine were to not exist, I want to keep on living.
records.en_auxiliary: Even if the Divine were to not exist, I want to keep on living.
records.en: Even if the Divine is not there,<CR>Kirara will continue to be Kirara.

records.jp: うん、そうだよ！<CR>自分の足で立って、自分の足で進もう！
records.en_original: Good! You don't need it! I know you can do it all yourself.
records.en_auxiliary: Good! You don't need it! I know you can do it all yourself.
records.en: Yeah, that's right!<CR>Stand on your own feet and move forward on your own feet!

records.jp: うん！
records.en_original: Yes!
records.en_auxiliary: Yes!
records.en: Yes!

records.jp: ……ふわっ！？
records.en_original: Whoa?!
records.en_auxiliary: Whoa?!
records.en: ...Fwagh!?

records.jp: うぅ、いたた……何か踏んづけた
records.en_original: Ow... I slipped on something.
records.en_auxiliary: Ow... I slipped on something.
records.en: Ugh, ow... Kirara stepped on something.

records.jp: これ、濡れた雑巾だ。<CR>なんか、すごいデジャヴなんですけど
records.en_original: A wet rag. I'm getting some crazy deja vu.
records.en_auxiliary: A wet rag. I'm getting some crazy deja vu.
records.en: This is a wet rag.<CR>I am getting some serious déjà vu.

records.jp: うぐぅ。<CR>やはり、きららには神の声がないと……
records.en_original: Urk... Perhaps I do need the Divine...
records.en_auxiliary: Urk... Perhaps I do need the Divine...
records.en: Ugh...<CR>After all, without the Divine's voice, Kirara...

records.jp: こらー！　もう、さっそく挫けない！<CR>……はい！
records.en_original: Hey, you just decided that you didn't! ...Here!
records.en_auxiliary: Hey, you just decided that you didn't! ...Here!
records.en: Hey! Do not get discouraged already!<CR>...Here!

records.jp: きららが転ばないように、<CR>私が手を繋いでてあげる
records.en_original: You can always take my hand if you feel like you're gonna fall.
records.en_auxiliary: You can always take my hand if you feel like you're gonna fall.
records.en: I will hold your hand<CR>so you do not fall, Kirara.

records.jp: 愛央……
records.en_original: Ao...
records.en_auxiliary: Ao...
records.en: Ao...

records.jp: ね。<CR>こうしてれば、転んでも平気でしょ？
records.en_original: See? You won't fall if we hold hands like this.
records.en_auxiliary: See? You won't fall if we hold hands like this.
records.en: See?<CR>If we stay like this, you will be fine even if you stumble, right?

records.jp: ……でも、もし<CR>きららのせいで、愛央まで転んだら？
records.en_original: But...I may cause you to fall along with me.
records.en_auxiliary: But...I may cause you to fall along with me.
records.en: ...But what if<CR>Ao falls too because of Kirara?

records.jp: その時は、一緒に起き上がるだけだよ。<CR>何度だってね
records.en_original: Then we just have to get back up. No matter how many times it happens.
records.en_auxiliary: Then we just have to get back up. No matter how many times it happens.
records.en: Then we will simply get back up together.<CR>No matter how many times it takes.

records.jp: ……うん。<CR>愛央の手、あったかいな
records.en_original: ...Okay. Your hand is so warm.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Okay. Your hand is so warm.
records.en: ...Yes.<CR>Ao's hand is warm.

records.jp: <CLGR>きらら<CLNR>のタレントに<CR>新たなタレントタイプが解放されました
records.en_original: A new Talent Type has been unlocked in <CLGR>Kirara's<CLNR> Talents.
records.en_auxiliary: A new Talent Type has been unlocked in <CLGR>Kirara's<CLNR> Talents.
records.en: A new Talent Type has been unlocked<CR>in <CLGR>Kirara's<CLNR> Talents.
